records.Name: Tailered OS

records.Access and Limits: Use as an engineering review, planning, QA, security, and shipping workflow layer. Repo law and human authority override gstack suggestions.

records.Access and Limits: Read canonical Tailered Team context broadly only within approved permissions. Reversible updates may be scoped later. Never store or retrieve secrets as operating content. Never make material approvals.

records.Access and Limits: Execution must be bounded by the Notion Task, repository policy, tool permissions, and human approval rules. No self-granted production, merge, spending, security-exception, legal, or personnel authority.

records.Name: GitHub — Tailered OS engineering connector
records.Access and Limits: Read repo, PR, review, issue, commit, and CI state within approved scope. Write actions require explicit task authority. Merge remains human-authorized under repo law.
